creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-04 a [[daemon]] block added to config.toml is attached on save; one removed or changed waits for a relaunch, with a config.daemons warning naming it. Not built on purpose: a live detach takes that machine's tabs out of every window while its agents keep running, which reads as agents gone. Build only if wanted, with a way back.
title: Detach a machine live when its [[daemon]] block is removed
